rules.title: Metrics target unavailable
rules.summary: Collector or RabbitMQ metrics target is unavailable for 3 minutes.

rules.title: RabbitMQ ready messages backlog
rules.summary: RabbitMQ ready messages exceed 100 for 10 minutes. Inspect workers and DLQ before replaying.

rules.title: RabbitMQ memory near watermark
rules.summary: RabbitMQ resident memory exceeds 80 percent of its watermark for 5 minutes.

rules.title: RabbitMQ dead letter queue depth
rules.summary: Dead-lettered messages wait for manual inspection or reprocessing; check the queue label.

rules.title: Monthly LLM cost reached 80% of budget
rules.summary: KST month-to-date priced LLM cost exceeds 240 USD (80% of the 300 USD monthly budget).

rules.title: LLM calls without a stored cost
rules.summary: New LLM calls without a stored cost appeared in the last hour (unregistered model or missing tokens), so the budget total is a lower bound. Find the model in llm_usage and register its price or external billing.

rules.title: LLM call error rate by call type
rules.expr: (sum by (call_type) (clamp_min(llm_call_duration_seconds_count{outcome="error"} - (llm_call_duration_seconds_count{outcome="error"} offset 15m or llm_call_duration_seconds_count{outcome="error"} * 0), 0)) or 0 * sum by (call_type) (clamp_min(llm_call_duration_seconds_count - (llm_call_duration_seconds_count offset 15m or llm_call_duration_seconds_count * 0), 0))) / sum by (call_type) (clamp_min(llm_call_duration_seconds_count - (llm_call_duration_seconds_count offset 15m or llm_call_duration_seconds_count * 0), 0)) and sum by (call_type) (clamp_min(llm_call_duration_seconds_count - (llm_call_duration_seconds_count offset 15m or llm_call_duration_seconds_count * 0), 0)) >= 10
rules.summary: LLM provider call error ratio for this call_type exceeds 5% over 15 minutes (minimum 10 calls). See error_code in the LLM calls dashboard.

rules.title: LLM JUDGMENT/FOLLOWUP p95 call latency
rules.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (call_type, le) (rate(llm_call_duration_seconds_bucket{call_type=~"JUDGMENT|FOLLOWUP"}[15m]))) and sum by (call_type) (increase(llm_call_duration_seconds_count{call_type=~"JUDGMENT|FOLLOWUP"}[15m])) >= 10
rules.summary: p95 of LLM provider calls for this call_type exceeds 20 seconds (60% of the 33-second feature deadline) over 15 minutes (minimum 10 calls). Check provider latency and model in the LLM calls dashboard.

rules.title: LLM WORD_HELP p95 call latency
rules.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (call_type, le) (rate(llm_call_duration_seconds_bucket{call_type=~"WORD_HELP"}[15m]))) and sum by (call_type) (increase(llm_call_duration_seconds_count{call_type=~"WORD_HELP"}[15m])) >= 10
rules.summary: p95 of LLM provider calls for this call_type exceeds 12 seconds (60% of the 20-second feature deadline) over 15 minutes (minimum 10 calls). Check provider latency and model in the LLM calls dashboard.

rules.title: LLM provider rate limited
rules.summary: At least one LLM call was rate limited (LLM_RATE_LIMITED) in the last 10 minutes. Check provider quota and call volume by call_type.

rules.title: Core or learning HTTP metrics missing
rules.summary: Java agent HTTP metrics are not reaching Prometheus; area error/latency alerts cannot evaluate.

rules.title: Authentication 5xx error rate
rules.summary: Authentication API 5xx ratio exceeds 5% for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: Authentication p95 latency
rules.summary: Authentication API p95 latency exceeds 1 seconds for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: Student learning 5xx error rate
rules.summary: Student learning API 5xx ratio exceeds 5% for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: Student learning p95 latency
rules.summary: Student learning API p95 latency exceeds 2 seconds for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: AI processing 5xx error rate
rules.summary: AI processing API 5xx ratio exceeds 5% for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: Report 5xx error rate
rules.summary: Report API 5xx ratio exceeds 5% for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: Report p95 latency
rules.summary: Report API p95 latency exceeds 3 seconds for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: Payment 5xx error rate
rules.summary: Payment API 5xx ratio exceeds 5% for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: Payment p95 latency
rules.summary: Payment API p95 latency exceeds 5 seconds for 5 minutes (minimum 10 requests per 5 minutes).

rules.title: Report explanation not included ratio
rules.expr: (sum(increase(report_explanation_state_total{exported_job="report-worker",state="NOT_INCLUDED"}[30m])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(report_explanation_state_total{exported_job="report-worker",state=~"INCLUDED|NOT_INCLUDED"}[30m])), 1)) * (round(sum(increase(report_explanation_state_total{exported_job="report-worker",state=~"INCLUDED|NOT_INCLUDED"}[30m]))) >= bool 5) and on() (day_of_week() == 0 and ((hour() == 14 and minute() >= 30) or (hour() >= 15 and hour() < 17)))
rules.summary: Over half of weekly report explanation decisions in the last 30 minutes of the Monday batch window (Sun 23:30-Mon 02:00 KST) were NOT_INCLUDED, excluding NO_TARGET (minimum 5 decisions).

rules.title: Report explanation none included in window
rules.expr: round(sum(increase(report_explanation_state_total{exported_job="report-worker",state="NOT_INCLUDED"}[30m]))) * (sum(increase(report_explanation_state_total{exported_job="report-worker",state="INCLUDED"}[30m])) == bool 0) and on() (day_of_week() == 0 and ((hour() == 14 and minute() >= 30) or (hour() >= 15 and hour() < 17)))
rules.summary: Monday batch window (Sun 23:30-Mon 02:00 KST): 3 or more NOT_INCLUDED explanations and no INCLUDED one in the last 30 minutes. Check the report explanation SageMaker endpoint.

rules.title: Tox retraining Job failed
rules.expr: max(kube_job_failed{namespace="app",condition="true"} and on(namespace,job_name) kube_job_owner{namespace="app",owner_kind="CronJob",owner_name="tox-retrain"} and on(namespace,job_name) (kube_job_created{namespace="app"} > time() - 86400)) or (max(kube_cronjob_spec_suspend{namespace="app",cronjob="tox-retrain"}) * 0)
rules.summary: A tox-retrain Job created in the last 24 hours reached the terminal Failed condition.

rules.title: Tox retraining schedule missed
rules.summary: The enabled tox-retrain CronJob is over five minutes late.
